sentence: This project studies how the cells that maintain stem cells change with age in a simple germline stem cell system.
This project tries to find out how mechanical forces guide the assembly of mechanosensory machinery in cells and change cell behavior and identity.
This project studies how anesthesia and surgery affect Alzheimer's disease changes such as inflammation and cognitive impairment in mice.
This project studies how disease-related variants of a gene alter receptor activity and synaptic signaling in cultured cells and brain slices.
This project builds imaging technology for cardiovascular medicine.
This project builds a low-cost tool that uses molecularly imprinted polymers to detect several disease biomarkers at the same time.
This project tests a technology that lowers the amount of gene therapy needed to treat cardiomyopathy, including in the hearts of mice.
This project studies how steroid hormone changes across the estrous cycle affect hippocampal and olfactory plasticity.
This project studies verbal and non-verbal behaviors to understand what makes social communication successful in autistic adolescents.
This project tries to find out whether and how traumatic brain injury causes vascular disease.
This project builds a protein footprinting technology that measures protein conformation and protein-protein interactions in single cancer cells.
This project develops small molecule drugs that block coronavirus proteins and stop the virus from replicating.
This project reads the RNA of single neurons in human trigeminal ganglion tissue from donors with and without migraine.
This project uses speech and language analysis with machine learning to detect dementia in Latinos.
This project studies how reading development is protected from atypical development in children from adverse developmental environments.
This project studies how dopamine changes activity in the striatum during associative-learning tasks in rodents.
This project tries to find out how non-coding RNA and chromatin regulation work together to keep pluripotent stem cells stable.
This project develops a method that separates and preserves metagenomic cells and DNA for later DNA sequencing analysis.
This project works on making interactions between workers and robotic and intelligent systems in mining safer.
